notes: Posted 11 November 2001, before Theed Palace, so the format is Premiere - Reflections III. The post calls it a 'Type II' deck (the Episode I-only format) with no Reflections III cards; every card is from the Tatooine and Coruscant sets.

Starting (5) as posted: My Lord, Is That Legal? / I Will Make It Legal, Coruscant: Galactic Senate, Tatooine: Desert Landing Site, We Must Accelerate Our Plans and The Phantom Menace; these count toward the 60. The author's edit says the starting Interrupt is Neimoidian Advisor, not We Must Accelerate Our Plans; the list is kept as posted (3 We Must Accelerate Our Plans, 1 Neimoidian Advisor) and Neimoidian Advisor is shown as the starting Interrupt.
Section headers with counts ('Senators (10)', 'Other Characters (11)', 'Political Effects (2)', 'Other Cards (2)', etc.) are not cards.

Because the deck is Episode I-only, posted 'Coruscant' dested Coruscant (Dark) (Coruscant), and 'Sense', 'Alter' and 'Control' dested the Coruscant-set Dark printings Sense (Dark) (Coruscant), Alter (Dark) (Coruscant) and Control (Dark) (Coruscant).

(Dark); 'Coruscant Guard' Coruscant Guard (Dark).
